title: Boitelo ba Boithatelo
intro: Nakong ea liteko tsa bomolimo, moea o ile oa bitsetsoa ketsong ea ho qetela ea ho ikokobetsa. Kaha o hōletse naheng e omeletseng, setšoantšo sena se ile sa hola sa bontša tumelo le mamello. Ha pono e laela sehlabelo, ha baa ka ba thekesela. Pale ea bona ke lejoe la motheo la boinehelo.
clues: Ke ne ke le karabo thapelong e neng e letetsoe ka nako e telele ea moprofeta e moholo.
’Na le ’Mè re ile ra sala phuleng e se nang batho re e-na le lijo tsa letsatsi le metsi feela.
Ke holetse ho fihlela ke e-ba moprofeta ea tsebahalang ka ho ba le 'nete le mamello.
Ke thusitse ntate ho phahamisa metheo ea ntlo e halalelang e inehetseng ho Allah.
Ha ntate a mpolella toro ea ho ntlhabela sehlabelo, ke ile ka re, 'Etsa kamoo u laetsoeng kateng.'
Allah o ile a hlompha boikokobetso ba ka ka ho romela pheleu e tsoang leholimong ho tla nthekolla.

trial.label: Nyeoe/Ketsahalo
options: Ho inehela ka boithatelo hore motho a etse sehlabelo
Ho metsoa ke tlhapi e kholo
Ho hlahlojoa ka lefu le tebileng
trial.answer: Ho inehela ka boithatelo hore motho a etse sehlabelo

outcome.label: Sephetho
options: O ile a lopolloa ka pheleu e kholo
O ne a filoe 'muso le bohlale
outcome.answer: O ile a lopolloa ka pheleu e kholo

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
